title: Explorer header and notices
responsibility: Provides explorer navigation and visible data-loading or missing-address messages.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.base
inputs.description: Required explorer URL prefix, passed to the navigation bar and prepended to a missing-address home link.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.links
inputs.description: Optional additional-view links, defaulting to an empty list. Used by the legacy header only.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.problem
inputs.description: Required problem text. A nonempty value is displayed as an alert.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.missing
inputs.type: { message: string; home: string | null } | null
inputs.description: Required missing-address information or null. Shows its message and a newest-revision link when home is provided.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.navbar
inputs.description: Optional navigation-bar context without its base, defaulting to null. When supplied, replaces the legacy heading and links.

outputs.name: HarnessHeader
outputs.description: Navigation bar or legacy heading, followed by problem and missing-address alerts. It renders supplied state and performs no data fetching.
